cameriere_italian_2006.label: Cameriere — Italian formula (open apices)
cameriere_italian_2006.age_range_note: Developed on Italian children; most accurate ~7-14 y (meta-analysis PMC7926662).

reported_stats.note: explained variance reported in original paper; confirm exact value

terms.desc: normalized open apex of the 2nd premolar = A5/L5
number of the 7 left mandibular teeth with CLOSED apices
sum of normalized open apices = sum(Ai/Li) over the 7 teeth

cameriere_italian_2006.verification_note: Coefficients cross-checked: PMC7926662 meta-analysis + medrech reproduction. DOI 10.1007/s00414-005-0047-9 (confirm).

cameriere_european_2007.label: Cameriere — European formula (open apices)
cameriere_european_2007.age_range_note: Multi-country European reference sample (~2652 children); most accurate ~7-14 y.

terms.desc: normalized open apex of the 2nd premolar = A5/L5 (coefficient is negative in the European multivariate fit)
number of the 7 left mandibular teeth with CLOSED apices
sum of normalized open apices = sum(Ai/Li) over the 7 teeth

cameriere_european_2007.verification_note: Coefficients cross-checked: primary 2007 paper PDF (u-pad.unimc.it) + PMC7926662 meta-analysis. DOI 10.1007/s00414-007-0179-1 confirmed.

cameriere_adult_upper_2009.label: Cameriere - adult, upper (maxillary) canine pulp/tooth area ratio
cameriere_adult_upper_2009.age_range_note: Combined Italian + Portuguese adult sample (~20-84 y). Input RA = pulp area / tooth area of the MAXILLARY canine, measured by planimetry on a peri-apical radiograph.

terms.desc: pulp/tooth AREA ratio of the maxillary (upper) canine

cameriere_adult_upper_2009.verification_note: Common (Italian + Portuguese) regression, Table 5 / Eq.(3) of Cameriere et al. 2009 (Forensic Sci Int 193:128.e1-e6), read at full resolution.

cameriere_adult_lower_2009.label: Cameriere - adult, lower (mandibular) canine pulp/tooth area ratio
cameriere_adult_lower_2009.age_range_note: Combined Italian + Portuguese adult sample. Input RA = pulp area / tooth area of the MANDIBULAR canine.

terms.desc: pulp/tooth AREA ratio of the mandibular (lower) canine

cameriere_adult_lower_2009.verification_note: Common (Italian + Portuguese) regression, Table 5 / Eq.(4) of Cameriere et al. 2009, read at full resolution.
